$comment: The source of sf-breadcrumbs's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/breadcrumbs (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

items.x-markup: the attribute takes the list as JSON or the "label::flag,key=value|label" form; without it the sf-breadcrumbs-item children are the list

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

x-summary: Shows the current page's place in a hierarchy as a trail of native links built from items, the items attribute or sf-breadcrumbs-item children. A long trail collapses its middle into an ellipsis button (max-items, default 4) that expands in place.
x-renamed: settings.items: type string with a list default → list (§4.2)
settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
events.sf-breadcrumb-click: "click" is a prototype name (§3.1) → press
events.press: 3 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
events.sf-breadcrumb-click → press: the DOM name is sf-breadcrumbs-press (§8 <tag>-<verb>); the old name is a dated split alias whose detail keeps component, tagName, template and originalEvent
settings.max-items: a number with integer and min (§4.2)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-breadcrumbs to show the current page location in a hierarchy and provide native links to ancestor pages.
do_not: Do not use Breadcrumbs as browsing history, tabs, a menu or a stepper
Do not omit href when an ancestor has a real URL
Do not expose separator icons to assistive technology
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

x-decisions: version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0, a minor while sf-breadcrumb-click holds a dated alias (§4.10).
events: a press on a crumb is `press` (click is a prototype name, §3.1), sent as sf-breadcrumbs-press, cancelable: a page that refuses it keeps the ellipsis closed, as it did with the old name.

detail-adapter: §8 takes the element and the browser's event out of detail, so sf-breadcrumbs-press carries {item, index, items}; sf-breadcrumb-click follows once with its old detail (component, tagName, template, originalEvent) through a split row and sfAliasAdapters, sharing one cancel.
key-effects: crumbs are native links and the ellipsis a native button: Tab reaches them, Enter follows a link or opens the hidden crumbs (select). No roving focus.
a11y-name: aria-label on the host, else the language file's runtime word «Хлебные крошки» / «Breadcrumb» (aria-label stays a host attribute, §3.1, alias row host-attribute).

item-shape: items name their fields with `of` (label, href, icon, current, disabled, ellipsis, target, rel, value, aria-label, item-class, container-class, hidden-items); the attribute keeps its JSON and "label::flags|" forms, and sf-breadcrumbs-item children stay the markup form.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus a long trail with the ellipsis, an icon home and children in the markup; probe.json drives Tab and Enter (gate 16).

css-variables: six public variables read by the class sheets (component/breadcrumbs) over the role tokens (§6): the gap, a crumb's colour, a link's colour at rest and on hover, the current crumb's colour and the separator's. They are not in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json yet: that file is shared with the field family's branches.
docs: docs/docs.md, where the folder keeps it (as sf-tooltip).
